recent_en: FOCUSP has recently been buying back shares on the open market and has made several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests. In August, the company declared a second interim dividend of 0.75 sen per share, with ex-date on 14 September and payment date on 25 September. There is also an announcement on a memorandum of understanding, but no details are provided.
notable_en: Declared a second interim dividend of 0.75 sen per share.
Directors and substantial shareholders acquired shares in open market transactions.
